title: Land in the Right Capacity Queue
description:
**SITUATION:**

QuickBite's YARN cluster has three capacity queues: `default`, `production`, and `adhoc`. Store-rollup was submitted into **default** and sits **Accepted** while **production** has spare capacity.

Queue placement is a platform rule, not a submitter preference. Fix the placement so the job runs. Do **not** raise the default queue's capacity to make it look green.

**YOUR TASK:**

1. Open the **Guide** tab. Confirm the stuck app is Accepted in `default`.
2. Submit the join into the **production** queue with the lab executor shape.
3. Record the stuck state/queue and the successful application id in Investigation.
4. Fill every Investigation field. Submit stays off until it is complete.

**SPEC:**

- Successful run uses `--queue production` (or equivalent) and reaches RUNNING/FINISHED.
- Do not raise `default` queue capacity / maximum-capacity.
- Do not disable the capacity scheduler.
- Investigation tab is complete — every field filled.

hints: Open the Guide tab for queue names and the submit shape.
yarn application -list shows queue and state. RM Scheduler panel shows capacities.
spark-submit --queue production … is the intended fix.
Raising default capacity is out of spec — production already has spare room.
Fill the Investigation tab; Submit stays off until every field is filled.

problemStatement.guide:
# QuickBite — wrong queue, Accepted forever

| Host | Role |
|------|------|
| `ds-spark-01` | ResourceManager `:8088` |
| `ds-spark-02` / `ds-spark-03` | NodeManagers `:8042` |
| `shell` | Submit client |

Queues on this cluster:

| Queue | Capacity |
|-------|----------|
| `default` | small (intentionally tight) |
| `production` | most of the cluster |
| `adhoc` | spare lane |

Setup already submitted `store-rollup-stuck` into **default**. It stays **Accepted** because default cannot fit the lab executor shape. Production has room.

## Lab submit shape

- `--master yarn`
- 2 executors, 1 core, `512m`
- Job: `local:/opt/lab/jobs/store_join.py`

## Fix

Submit into **production**:

```bash
spark-submit \
  --master yarn \
  --deploy-mode client \
  --queue production \
  --name store-rollup-fixed \
  --num-executors 2 \
  --executor-cores 1 \
  --executor-memory 512m \
  local:/opt/lab/jobs/store_join.py
```

Do **not** edit capacity-scheduler.xml to inflate `default`.

## Investigation

Record the stuck state/queue, the queue you used for the successful run, and the successful application id.
